clinical_rationale: Chronic hypertension accelerates myocardial oxygen demand and plaque rupture risk
Baseline hypertension predisposes to acute hypertensive crisis
Diabetes can cause silent or atypical myocardial ischemia
Insulin deficiency triggers rapid ketoacidosis progression
Impaired immune response increases sepsis risk
Prior coronary disease directly elevates Acute Coronary Syndrome probability
Existing reactive airway disease amplifies acute bronchospasm severity
Baseline lung compromise increases hypoxia risk during pneumonia
Immunocompromised patients progress rapidly to septic shock
Anticoagulation dramatically raises intracranial bleed risk
Prior severe allergy history primes rapid anaphylactic reaction
Advanced age increases acute cardiac mortality risk
Elderly patients have higher sepsis decompensation rates
Advanced age increases pneumonia hospitalization need
